title: True Pinball
overview:
True Pinball Breaks the Mold, but Not the Laws of Gravity.

True Pinball is the ultimate fully rendered, high speed propulsion into the electronic world of pinball fervor.

Why? Because it incorporates four tables, multiballs, video modes, 2D and 3D views, and over 32,000 colors. Because it remains faithful to every aspect of mathematical precision right down to gravity conditions. That's why it adds up to the fastest, most accurate pinball sim on the market and shatters the mold of what we are asked to expect.

Features
- Choose from four detailed tables - Babewatch, Extreme Sports, Vikings and Law 'n Justice.
- Rack up points against your friends! Up to eight players can flip the flippers with a single control pad.
- Shoot the ramps from two angles - elevated 3D or top-down 2D.
- With up to six balls in play at once, this game will challenge the most hardened gamer.
